lane_rules.failure_policy: any failed stage closes that stage and rolls back to the previous passed stage; thresholds are frozen per stage protocol before execution

host_note: gcb is the recovered-lane name of the historical GSS episode; all ladder text referring to the GSS host maps to the gcb executor.
evidence_note: recovered-lane Phase-I checkpoints expose block-pair RelationEvidence (left_block/right_block/strength/disagreement) and a disjoint block partition; they carry no per-variable shared-variable marker. Stage protocols must preregister the executor-lane translation of plan-level quantities that assumed per-variable overlap membership.
